title: git kura open — envelope data
description: Command-specific schema for the data payload of `git kura open --json` (both dry-run and actual open), nested under the common envelope's data field.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this data payload.

key.description: The key passed to the command.

repositoryRoot.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

baseBranch.description: Branch the worktree was (or would be) created from.

exists.description: Whether the worktree directory exists. Always false for dry-run.

dirty.description: Whether the worktree has uncommitted changes. Always false for dry-run.

createdWorktree.description: Whether this invocation created the git worktree. Present only for actual open (not dry-run).

createdBranch.description: Whether this invocation created the branch. Present only for actual open (not dry-run).

createdMetadata.description: Whether this invocation created the kura metadata file. Present only for actual open (not dry-run).
